_comment: Ablation config for NeRF-DS (WITH mask, ignore_mask=false), parameter under test = sparse_anchor.anchor_stride (see the 'ablation' section below). Based on configs_nerf_ds_with_mask.json but with a shrunk iteration/densification budget so the full sweep (7 scenes x len(ablation.values) stride settings) fits a 20-24h H100 20GB budget -- see full_ablation.py's docstring for the full time-budget derivation. anchor_stride itself is NOT read from this file's sparse_anchor.anchor_stride at run time: full_ablation.py overrides it per run via train.py's --anchor_stride CLI flag (CLI always wins over configs.json, see arguments/__init__.py's ParamGroup), the value here is only the fallback default if the script is ever invoked oddly. densify_grad_threshold raised and densify_until_iter shortened (vs. the 40000-iter with-mask baseline) specifically to cap peak Gaussian count N, since the smallest ablation stride (most anchors M) is the most memory-hungry case and this config must stay safe across the WHOLE sweep on a 20GB card, not just the default stride.

ablation._comment: 4 values x 7 nerf_ds scenes = 28 runs. Smaller stride = more anchors = slower/heavier; larger stride = fewer anchors = faster/lighter -- the sweep deliberately spans both sides of the with-mask baseline default (8).
